name: SITC2026 S17 - Module B
description: Build a server-rendered SwapLoop administration console for a fictional Shanghai e-bike battery swapping and monitored charging pilot. Implement staff auth with role scoping, community enrolment, station lifecycle, Station Service–backed live capacity, battery quarantine/retire, incident resolution, partner priority windows, and a funding/rollout dashboard against a compact admin database seed — independently of Module C.
